_doc: Fifth photo-match session (2026-11-16): the reading, by a person, of every sentence that loc_reread.py listed as a place or direction cue in a record that no statement covers.

2018670700.reading: the title says only what the woods show (musket fire on Culp's Hill); the camera place is not stated

2018670711.reading: a portrait of Brady seated on the steps of the Burns cottage; the sentence says who sits where on the house, not where the camera stood

2018670717.reading: the caption says the view is of the breastworks on Round Top, the hill that formed the Federal extreme left: the subject; the Library's negative sleeve caption does not say where the camera stood (the first catalogue run made no statement for the same wording)

2018671419.reading: a sign of the 1880s in the McPherson Woods: not July 1863

2025160089.reading: the summary says dead horses and ruins about the Trostle house: the subject; Gardner's printed title (Sketch Book plate 42) and the letterpress describe the house and the fight, not the place of the camera

2025160541.reading: a monument tablet on Cemetery Ridge photographed later (the sentence names what the tablet commemorates and a view of Culp's Hill beyond): outside the July 1863 terrain test; the record is not digitized

2013645948.reading: the title says the barn on the left is where Sickles had his headquarters: a statement about the building, made by the card's publisher; the place of the camera is not stated

2011649197.reading: a man lying among shot-torn trees near Culp's Hill (Tipton, made later than July 1863 by the Library's own dating): the place of the subject, not of the camera

2011649196.reading: the same wording and subject as 2011649197 (a second print of the card): the place of the subject near Culp's Hill, not of the camera

2011646177.reading: a stereo card of the breastworks on Round Top, with the same title as the negative sleeve caption of 2018670717; the subject, not the camera

2025169709.reading: the summary says the farmhouse on Cemetery Ridge owned by Lydia Leister: the subject; Gardner's plate 43 letterpress places the house on the road to Taneytown just back of the cemetery and does not say where the camera stood

2006692513.reading: the Sketch Book plate 42 summary says slaughtered animals behind a house: the subject; the letterpress was read by machine and by eye and says where the house stands (in front of the left of the position), not where the camera stood

2011649195.reading: Tipton card of men at a fence looking toward a meadow: the people look, the camera place is not stated; made after the battle

2006692514.reading: the Sketch Book plate 43 summary says the house used as headquarters: the subject; the letterpress places the house just back of the cemetery on the road to Taneytown, not the camera

2026167355.reading: a portrait of a soldier wounded at Spotsylvania: not a battlefield view of July 1863
